# Codebase-Aware API Change Radar (idea-167)

**Score:** 8.26/10  |  **Category:** Developer Tools

## Executive Summary
Scans codebases for API calls, SDK methods, and webhooks to highlight breaking documentation & changelog changes.

## Product Description
Connects official API changelogs directly to affected files, tests, and endpoints in a repository instead of generic page-change notifications.

## 7-Day Payment Experiment
Offer standardized $49 report. Target 3 paid pre-orders within 7 days.
